title: Doner Villager
description: Adds a Doner and shawarma making villager proffession
body:
# 🥙 Doner Villager Datapack
> Transform your Minecraft world into a bustling Doner shop with custom workstations, unique villagers, and 10+  food items!
![donerman](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a5a3470f56633afcbbfa24c639120495665c14da.png)
---

## 🌟 Key Features
- **Custom Workstation:** A dynamic, spinning meat spit summoned via a unique in-world block combo.
- **The Doner Chef:** A specialized Master-level villager that manages your shop.
- **Recipe-Based Trading:** Trade emeralds and base ingredients for high-tier specialty dishes.
- **Powerful Buffs:** Each food item provides unique, survival-ready effects.
- **Job Security:** Villagers stay locked into their profession once assigned.

---

## 🛠️ Summoning Ritual
To set up your first Doner shop, construct the following structure:
1. **The Base:** Place an **Iron Block** on the ground.
2. **The Spit:** Place **Iron Bars** directly on top of the Iron Block.
3. **The Ritual:** Drop **1x Raw Mutton** (*Q-key*) onto the Iron Block.
   - ⚡ *An explosion of fire and sparks will signal the successful summoning of the spinning meat spit, accompanied by a celebratory Piano Tarabana jingle!*

---

## 👨‍🍳 The Doner Chef
Any nearby unemployed villager will be drawn to the workstation and become the **Doner Chef**.
- **Instant Mastery:** Chefs start at **Level 5 (Master)**, unlocking the entire menu immediately.
- **Custom UI:** The trading menu is titled **"Doner Chef"** for a premium feel.
- **Job Loss:** Breaking either the **Iron Block** or **Iron Bars** will cause the Chef to lose their job and revert to a normal villager, clearing their custom trades.

---

## 🌯 The Specialty Menu
The Doner Chef specializes in 10 unique items. All effects are applied instantly upon consumption.

| Item | Cost | Ingredients | Effects |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Pita Bread** | 1 Emerald | - | 📦 *Gives 6x Bread* |
| **Arabian Shawarma** | 4 Emeralds | 1x Bread | ⚡ **Speed I** (20s) |
| **Fries** | 5 Emeralds | 1x Baked Potato | ⛏️ **Haste I** (15s) |
| **Chicken Shawarma** | 6 Emeralds | 1x Cooked Chicken | 🐇 **Jump Boost II** (30s) |
| **Hummus** | 5 Emeralds | 1x Mushroom Stew | 🛡️ **Resistance I** (20s) |
| **Kebab** | 8 Emeralds | 1x Cooked Mutton | ⚔️ **Strength I** (30s) |
| **Ayran** | 3 Emeralds | 1x Milk Bucket | ✨ **Clears Negative Effects** + Regen I |
| **Doner** | 12 Emeralds | 1x Cooked Beef | ❤️ **Regeneration II** + Absorption |
| **The Doner Feast** | 32 Emeralds | 1x Doner | 👑 **Health Boost II** (2m), Str II, Saturation |
![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b1704897c194da38d70cda230cbf87aa6a04dcaf.png)
---

## 💰 Resource Trade-Ins
Need more emeralds? The Chef buys raw meat at optimal rates:
- **Raw Beef:** 10 for 1 Emerald
- **Raw Mutton:** 7 for 1 Emerald

---

## ⚙️ Technical Details
- **Version:** Minecraft 1.21.1+
- **Commands:** Use `/reload` after installing to initialize system scores.
- **Performance:** Optimized tick loops ensure minimal impact on server performance.

---
